visualCharacteristics.purpose: thin strip with a label beside a single-line, slash-separated rail of links
visualCharacteristics.summary: A thin single-line strip: a narrow label tab beside a slash-separated inline link rail.

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: label (Lo más visto); list of links (use full link titles)
contentPattern.notes: The section hint is block, and the content is a fixed side-by-side pair (label and link list) that never wraps.

usage: Most-viewed or quick-links strip under the header. Links keep their full text in the title tooltip when truncated.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any label + inline link rail. Use the base columns for real side-by-side content.
